title: In development
summary: Unavailable projects and specific limits still under investigation.
body:
These projects are not yet available, or have a specific unresolved boundary. Installed systems and their instructions are in Features and Guides; deployment history is in Change Log.

The Ashen Compact — live testing

The Ashen Compact is an installed level-50 Shadow Knight helmet campaign in a curated Kael expedition. Its paired server and client release is available for testing; full encounter, rendering and balance acceptance remain open.

Separate level-65 and Planes of Power profile — not released

The expanded pet equipment and scaling changes are installed, but the level-65/Planes of Power profile and 389 additional merchant entries are still staged. Classic level 50 remains active. Nothing grants levels, spellbooks, AA points or epics automatically. Manifest Elements keeps its normal Mage level 59 requirement.

Remaining shared skill and spell cooldowns

The AA and cross-ability timer correction is deployed for live testing. Content-defined groups, including Harmshield/Cannibalize and Battle Cry/Throw Stone, remain open work. Bash/Slam, Backstab, Frenzy and non-Monk Kick still share a basic attack timer; Begging and Pick Pockets also share reuse. Linked potion/item groups remain. These links are under review; they are not included in the independence correction.

Adventure Journal & Epic 0.5 — live testing

Wayfarer’s Oath: The Last Lantern is installed: three shared chapters, one chosen oath path and eight continuations through level50, with an earned eight-piece outfit and chapter-based refits. The charm and armor are available earned rewards.

Full player pathing, appearance and encounter acceptance remain open. Fully exit the game and use launcher Play for signed update2026110701.

Combat and item candidates

Broader Monk and Beastlord fist-damage formulas and some existing tiered item corrections have a tested candidate but no recorded deployment. A frozen personal casting bar remains under investigation. The separate extra-class skill, trainer and offhand correction is deployed; the reported player issue was confirmed resolved.

Ongoing checks for deployed features

Broader equipment and class combinations, stats, regeneration, ability names and Bard movement/songs still need player checks. Those are acceptance checks for installed systems, not a claim that all of them are unreleased. See Features for the available systems.

Commonlands player bazaar — live testing

Native search, fixed-price listings, offline seller proceeds and cancellation are installed. Actual RoF2 search, inspection, direct delivery and complete seller/buyer checks remain open. No auctioneer character needs to remain online. Market guide and restrictions.

Paladin weapon repair — live testing

The paired October28 release installs the grip-definition repair, assessed stats and direct Ascended rewards for all three sword quests. Fiery Defender no longer needs the extra payment step; existing normal Defenders have a free exchange. Monk AAs are unchanged. Player checks for shield use, visible swings, quest exchange and persistence remain open. Current grip behavior and restrictions.

Plane of Hate layout — live testing

The paired Hate server and client update is installed for testing. New Keeper runs use ground-level routes while existing runs remain in the original layout. Nightcap encounters, loot and earned rewards are preserved. Rendering, routes, pulls and full-run acceptance remain open. Current entry and testing guide.

Keyless doors — live testing

The removal of ordinary door key and lock-picking requirements is installed. Guild, scripted and zone/instance access rules remain. Scope and instructions; native player checks remain open.

Public Cazic-Thule — live testing

The Classic population is restored for ordinary travel through Khaleid. Player checks for rendering, patrols, loot and unchanged private runs remain open. Entry and encounter rules.

Faction standings — live testing

The deployed #factions command adds white-text standings, bars, search and paging. Native readability and in-game acceptance remain open. Command instructions.

Power Source training — Not released

A candidate adds item advancement through combat XP, alongside the Reforging Box. The proposed 4–8-hour full path needs timed gameplay and client verification before release. Power Source training preview.

Not released: the November 6 augment audit preview lists all top-quality augments and proposed guard-wide drops, specialty bonuses and exotic icons. Current live behavior remains until a verified release.

Augment icon correction — live testing

The native correction is deployed: stat augments preserve equipment icons and genuine cosmetic transformations. Full player visual acceptance remains open. Equipment guidance.

Quick Buff hotkey — live testing

The activated Quick Buff hotkey is deployed for testing: immediate eligible memorized buffs, 50% maximum mana once, no reuse delay and normal group/pet delivery. Fully exit EverQuest and use launcher Play. Instructions and limits. Player and balance acceptance remain open.

DoT landing damage removed — live testing

Player DoTs keep instant casts and normal ticks while losing the separate immediate damage hit on spells that have one. No client download is needed. Examples and test expectations. Owner gameplay and balance acceptance remain open.

Earned titles

77 cosmetic titles for slayer ranks, named dragons, Classic Raid completion, skills and adventure milestones. Implemented candidate; tracking, unlocks and command are not enabled on the live server.

Classic sympathetic clicks · test candidate

The Ascended Runed Lava Pendant from a lava elemental in Solusek’s Eye grants Strike I. The Ascended Moonstone Ring from a frenzied ghoul in Lower Guk grants Healing I. Equip and click either to gain its buff, then swap back to your preferred gear. A qualifying direct damage spell adds a separate hit. A qualifying direct heal adds a burst to its recipient. Each burst adds 5% of the largest eligible hit or heal from that cast, rounded down, up to 48. The Ring retains Extended Range II. Higher ranks await expansion review.
